description: This Lua script performs extensive tests and validations on the math library, including numeric limits, floating-point precision, conversions, random number generation, and edge cases like NaN and infinity.

methods.name: isNaN
methods.description: Checks if a number is NaN by comparing it to itself.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Compares two floating-point numbers for approximate equality within a limit.

methods.name: eqT
methods.description: Checks if two values are equal and of the same type.

methods.name: checkerror
methods.description: Executes a function and asserts that it raises an error containing a specific message.
